name: held-out example
wording: an example kept from builders and used only in judgment, so passing the visible examples while missing the concept is caught; it is kept back by omission alone, never named to a builder or mentioned, since a prohibition would announce it. When one fails, builders learn the concept and the shortfall but not the case, and a case revealed to fix it becomes visible and is replaced by a new held-out one.
reason: Restated as current meaning only: plain words, with decision numbers, history and how it is built left out; its meaning is unchanged.
